notes: 16-club 2026 LigaPro Serie A roster confirmed via Wikipedia (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_LigaPro_Serie_A): Aucas, Barcelona SC, Delfín, Deportivo Cuenca, Emelec, Guayaquil City, Independiente del Valle, LDU Quito, Leones, Libertad, Macará, Manta, Mushuc Runa, Orense, Técnico Universitario, Universidad Católica. Promoted for 2026: Guayaquil City and Leones (from Serie B). The same source's prose also listed Técnico Universitario as relegated 'from the 2025 season' alongside Vinotinto Ecuador, which contradicts its own 16-club table listing Técnico Universitario as a 2026 participant — treated the table (the definitive current-season list) as authoritative over that one contradictory sentence, most likely stale wording left over from an earlier revision of the article.

10 of 16 club badges sourced live from TheSportsDB's 'Ecuadorian Serie A' team list. That list is missing 6 smaller/newly-promoted clubs (Macará, Manta, Mushuc Runa, Orense, Técnico Universitario, Universidad Católica) even though they're all 2026 top-flight sides — checking TheSportsDB's 'Ecuadorian Serie B' list and alternate league-name spellings didn't surface them either, so this is a real gap in that source, not a lookup mistake. Técnico Universitario and Universidad Católica each have a real crest on Wikimedia Commons and are used from there; Macará, Manta, Mushuc Runa and Orense have no crest file found on Commons or TheSportsDB — left as logoUrl: null (ClubBadge's built-in initials/color fallback covers these, same as any other club with a genuinely unfound crest elsewhere in this dataset).

Ecuador is CONMEBOL, so — same as AR/BR/CO/UY — it lists both CONMEBOL Copa Libertadores (continental-cup slot) and CONMEBOL Copa Sudamericana (europa-league slot, added to merge.py's SECOND_TIER_CONTINENTAL_NAMES this same session) using the identical, already-verified trophy image URLs used for those four countries.

Supercopa Ecuador is an active, currently-running competition (2026 edition: Independiente del Valle 3-0 Universidad Católica, per en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Supercopa_Ecuador) — included as super-cup, not omitted.

All trophy images (league, cup, supercup) sourced live from TheSportsDB's lookupleague.php strTrophy field for idLeague 4686 (Ecuadorian Serie A), 5636 (Copa Ecuador), and 5884 (Supercopa Ecuador) respectively.

The LigaPro Serie A trophy image bundled locally for real in-app display (see TrophyImage.tsx) is a user-supplied image separate from the trophyImageUrl above, which — like the rest of this file's trophyImageUrl fields across the whole dataset — is unused research provenance, not something the app renders directly.
